title: The river feature's own population list. On RIVER4 every animal entry in feature_init_outdoor_riverst.feature.population reads count_min 0 against a full count_max, while region-level surface populations read count_min close to count_max. Same river-only whitelist as E26b on the site pool, plus count_min raised to count_max on the feature's own list. A season, stopping at four arrivals.
fork: E26b on RIVER3 (a year) and RIVER4 (a year) drew nothing with the site pool wide open. If the draw reads the world-level feature list, its zero minimum is the closed door.

predictions.model: the draw reads the feature's world-level count
predictions.expects: river-species arrivals with layer=feature within the season, none in E26b

predictions.model: the feature list is bookkeeping only
predictions.expects: nothing arrives; the door is elsewhere or absent

kill_criterion: one river-species arrival with a fresh countdown and no mother settles it
culling: drop a replicate on any breach or changed save

arms.name: feature_min_raised
pre: local RIVER={['ALLIGATOR']=true,['ALLIGATOR SNAPPING TURTLE']=true,['BEAVER']=true,['BIRD_OSPREY']=true,['CROCODILE_SALTWATER']=true,['FISH_CARP']=true,['FISH_GAR_LONGNOSE']=true,['FISH_LAMPREY_SEA']=true,['FISH_MILKFISH']=true,['FISH_PIKE']=true,['FISH_STINGRAY']=true,['FISH_STURGEON']=true,['FISH_TIGERFISH']=true,['HIPPO']=true,['MINK']=true,['PLATYPUS']=true,['RIVER OTTER']=true,['SNAPPING TURTLE']=true,['SPONGE']=true}; local site=df.world_site.find(df.global.plotinfo.site_id); local x0,x1=math.floor(site.global_min_x/16),math.floor(site.global_max_x/16); local y0,y1=math.floor(site.global_min_y/16),math.floor(site.global_max_y/16); local o,c,k,u=0,0,0,0; for _,p in ipairs(df.global.world.populations.all) do local r=p.population; if p.type==df.world_population_type.Animal then local cr=df.creature_raw.find(p.race); local id=cr and cr.creature_id or ''; local inring=(r.region_x>=x0-1 and r.region_x<=x1+1 and r.region_y>=y0-1 and r.region_y<=y1+1); if RIVER[id] then if p.quantity<50 then p.quantity=50 end; p.flags.extinct=false; o=o+1 elseif inring then if p.quantity_max>=10000000 then u=u+1 end; p.quantity=0; p.flags.extinct=true; c=c+1 else k=k+1 end end end; print(('river whitelist: %d river-species entries open (>=50, any tile, any layer); %d non-river entries on site+ring closed (surface, cavern, feature alike); %d entries beyond the ring left alone; %d of the closed were unbounded (underworld) entries'):format(o,c,k,u))

local r=df.global.world.raws.creatures.all; local n,tot=0,0; for i,fi in ipairs(df.global.world.features.map_features) do if tostring(fi._type):find('outdoor_river') then local f=fi.feature; for j=0,#f.population-1 do local p=f.population[j]; if p.type==df.world_population_type.Animal then tot=tot+1; if p.count_min<p.count_max then p.count_min=p.count_max; n=n+1 end end end; print(('river feature %d: count_min raised to count_max on %d of %d animal entries; irritation %d'):format(i, n, tot, f.irritation_level)) end end
